headline: Daily market snapshot 2026-10-05
summary: Oct 2 close: S&P 500 7670.36 (+0.25%), Dow 50927.33 (+0.04%), Nasdaq 26871.60 (+0.04%). On Oct 5: BTC $86,054, Brent $101.31, gold $4,138.78, 10Y UST 5.26%, DXY 101.93. Oct 5 futures modestly lower after Friday's weak NFP.

headline: US September payrolls miss badly at +29K; unemployment ticks up to 4.2%
summary: The US economy added only 29,000 nonfarm payroll jobs in September 2026, well below the ~84,000 consensus estimate, and unemployment edged to 4.2%. Prior months were revised down by 60,000 combined (July to -10K, August to 133K). Wages rose just 0.1% MoM and 3.0% YoY, the slowest annual gain since 2021.

headline: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures drift lower ahead of ISM Services data
summary: US equity futures edged modestly lower Monday morning as investors assessed elevated bond yields and the upcoming Q3 earnings season, following Friday's surprise jobs miss that pared Fed rate-hike expectations. Dow futures fell 0.2%, S&P 500 futures -0.1%, and Nasdaq-100 futures slipped into the red. ISM Services PMI at 10:00 AM ET is the day's main data point.
key_facts: ISM Services PMI due 10:00 AM ET
FOMC Sep minutes due Wednesday Oct 7

headline: Bitcoin rises above $86,000 as traders price out October Fed rate hike
summary: Bitcoin climbed above $86,000 on Monday, gaining about 1% after a sharply weaker-than-expected September jobs report led investors to slash bets on a Fed hike at the October 28 meeting. Ethereum gained ~1% to $2,727. Crypto markets are responding bullishly to the reduced tightening odds.
key_facts: Oct Fed hike probability fell to ~23% post-NFP miss

headline: Fed Oct hike odds plunge to 23% after weak September payrolls
summary: Following September's surprisingly weak +29K payroll print, prediction markets lowered the probability of a Fed hike at the October 28 FOMC meeting to roughly 23%, from a prior ~55%. The Fed raised rates 25bps to 3.75-4.00% on September 16; its dot plot showed one more 2026 hike expected by the median member.
key_facts: Oct 28 FOMC: 77% hold, 23% hike priced post-NFP
Dot plot: median sees 1 more hike in 2026
FOMC Sep minutes release due Oct 7 at 2pm ET

headline: Tesla Q3 2026 deliveries beat at 486,532, topping 461,974 consensus
summary: Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in Q3 2026, exceeding the Wall Street consensus of ~461,974 by roughly 5.3%. Model 3/Y accounted for 478,237 units. Energy storage deployments were 13.7 GWh. The stock rose 4.65% on October 2 following the release. Tesla remains the only Magnificent Seven stock in the red for 2026, down ~23% YTD.
key_facts: TSLA -23% YTD, only Mag7 stock in red

headline: Accenture Q4 FY2026 revenue $18.7B beats, FY26 total $74.2B; dividend up 10%
summary: Accenture reported Q4 FY2026 revenue of $18.7 billion with local-currency growth of 7% year-over-year, topping estimates. Full-year revenue reached $74.2 billion. Adjusted EPS gained 8%. New bookings were $22.2 billion in Q4. The company raised its FY2026 earnings outlook, boosted its quarterly dividend 10% to $1.63 per share, and announced a $2 billion increase to its share repurchase program. ACN surged ~18-19% premarket.
key_facts: $2B increase to buyback program ($7.5B total FY26)

headline: Eli Lilly terminates SMARCA2 collaboration with Foghorn Therapeutics; FHTX -49%
summary: Eli Lilly terminated its SMARCA2 cancer drug collaboration with Foghorn Therapeutics after FHD-909 failed to demonstrate sufficient efficacy in early-stage trials, despite hitting the target with a favorable safety profile. The partnership, originally valued at up to $1.6 billion, will not advance FHD-909 or a separate SMARCA2 program. Foghorn cut 40% of its workforce and the stock plunged ~49% to $1.84, its largest single-session decline ever.
key_facts: FHD-909 failed efficacy; SMARCA2/4 synthetic lethality did not translate

headline: Liquidia continues slide; UTHR wins patent war over Yutrepia PH-ILD use
summary: Liquidia (LQDA) shares continued lower Monday, extending the 57% crash from September 30 when a Delaware court ruled Yutrepia infringes valid United Therapeutics '327 patent claims covering PH-ILD treatment with inhaled treprostinil. United Therapeutics is seeking an injunction limiting Yutrepia's availability. Liquidia will appeal and ask the FDA to remove PH-ILD from the Yutrepia label.
key_facts: Sep 30 court ruling: Yutrepia infringes UTHR '327 patent (PH-ILD)
LQDA -57% on Sep 30, -14.9% continuing premarket Oct 5
UTHR seeks injunction on Yutrepia PH-ILD indication
Liquidia will appeal and seek FDA label removal

headline: BTIG upgrades United Therapeutics to Buy, sets $728 target after patent win
summary: BTIG upgraded United Therapeutics (UTHR) to Buy from Neutral and set a $728 price target, citing the Delaware court's patent ruling in UTHR's favor over Liquidia's Yutrepia as clearing a path for resumed revenue growth through 2027 and beyond.
key_facts: BTIG upgrades UTHR to Buy from Neutral
Catalyst: patent ruling vs Liquidia clears path to growth through 2027

headline: KeyBanc raises Nvidia price target to $740 from $650, maintains Overweight
summary: KeyBanc Capital Markets raised its Nvidia (NVDA) price target to $740 from $650, maintaining an Overweight rating. Nvidia rose ~1.34% on October 2 to a record, with its market cap reaching approximately $5.72 trillion after a strong run YTD (+23%+).

headline: Nvidia hits record market cap of $5.72 trillion, stock +23% YTD
summary: Nvidia shares rose 1.34% on October 2 to a new record, pushing its market capitalization to approximately $5.72 trillion. The AI chip giant is up over 23% in 2026, powered by surging data center and AI demand. KeyBanc raised its price target to $740 (Overweight) on October 5.
key_facts: AI data center demand driving growth

headline: Wells Fargo downgrades Exxon Mobil to Equal Weight, target $182
summary: Wells Fargo downgraded ExxonMobil (XOM) to Equal Weight from Overweight with a price target of $182, citing valuation concerns after the stock's strong run alongside elevated oil prices. On the same day, Wells Fargo upgraded BP to Overweight with a $57 target.
key_facts: Wells Fargo downgrades XOM to Equal Weight (was Overweight), PT $182
Wells Fargo upgrades BP to Overweight, PT $57 (from $48)

headline: Wells Fargo upgrades BP ADR to Overweight, raises target to $57
summary: Wells Fargo upgraded BP ADR to Overweight and raised its price target to $57 from $48. The upgrade comes alongside a simultaneous downgrade of Exxon Mobil to Equal Weight.
key_facts: Wells Fargo upgrades BP to Overweight (from prior rating)

headline: Barclays cuts Mobileye to Equal Weight, $9 target on no large content wins and CEO transition
summary: Barclays downgraded Mobileye Global (MBLY) to Equalweight with a $9 price target, citing no large advanced-driver-assistance wins in the near term and uncertainty surrounding a CEO transition.
key_facts: No large ADAS content wins expected near term

headline: BofA cuts Fair Isaac (FICO) to Neutral, slashes target to $700 from $1,400
summary: Bank of America Securities cut Fair Isaac Corporation (FICO) to Neutral with a price target of $700, down sharply from $1,400, citing valuation concerns after the stock's dramatic run.
key_facts: BofA cuts FICO to Neutral (from Buy)

headline: Raymond James downgrades Liquidia to Outperform, slashes target to $53 from $106
summary: Raymond James downgraded Liquidia (LQDA) to Outperform from Strong Buy and cut its price target to $53 from $106 following the Delaware court ruling against Liquidia's Yutrepia in the PH-ILD patent dispute with United Therapeutics.
key_facts: Raymond James downgrades LQDA to Outperform from Strong Buy
Post-patent loss: court ruled Yutrepia infringes UTHR '327 patent

headline: ISM Services PMI for September due at 10 AM ET Monday; consensus ~55.1
summary: The ISM Services PMI for September 2026 is due at 10:00 AM ET on October 5. Consensus is approximately 55.1, slightly below the August reading of 55.4 which marked 26 consecutive months of services expansion. The data will be watched for signs of economic resilience after Friday's weak payrolls.
key_facts: ISM Services PMI Sep due 10AM ET Oct 5

headline: Brent crude eases to $101.31 but remains elevated on Iran-Hormuz tensions
summary: Brent crude fell 0.92% to $101.31 per barrel on October 5 while WTI traded around $90.56. Prices remain elevated—Brent is up more than 54% year-over-year—as flows through the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb remain constrained by ongoing US-Iran military tension and new sanctions from the Treasury's OFAC.
key_facts: Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb flows constrained

headline: Gold struggles below $4,200 as elevated yields and firmer dollar weigh
summary: Gold fell to $4,138.78 per troy ounce on October 5, down 0.03%, as elevated Treasury yields (10Y at 5.26%, the highest since 2002) and a firmer US dollar (DXY 101.93) restrained bullion. Gold is headed for a second consecutive weekly decline despite a weak US jobs report.
key_facts: Second consecutive weekly decline for gold

headline: Corteva completes spin-off of seed unit Vylor Inc. on October 1
summary: Corteva (CTVA) completed its planned separation of its seed operating segment into independent publicly traded company Vylor Inc. on October 1, 2026. Corteva shareholders received one Vylor share per CTVA share held at the September 24 record date. Corteva now operates solely as a crop-protection company. CTVA shares adjusted sharply lower to reflect the distribution.
key_facts: Corteva Vylor seed unit spin-off completed Oct 1 2026
1:1 share distribution at Sep 24 record date
CTVA market cap down >$42B post-distribution adjustment
Legal challenge from California overruled by 4th Circuit

headline: Anthropic IPO expected to slip to November 2026, targeting ~$2 trillion valuation
summary: Anthropic's anticipated IPO, initially targeting October 2026, is now expected to price in November 2026 on the Nasdaq, per WSJ and Reuters. The AI company is targeting proceeds of up to $100 billion at a ~$2 trillion valuation—which would be one of the largest IPOs ever. Anthropic's most recent Series H valued it at ~$965 billion, with annualized revenue of $47 billion as of May 2026.
key_facts: Anthropic IPO targeting November 2026 (slipped from October)
Last funding: $65B Series H at ~$965B post-money valuation

headline: FOMC September 15-16 meeting minutes to be released October 7 at 2 PM ET
summary: The Federal Reserve will release minutes from its September 15-16 FOMC meeting on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 at 2:00 PM ET. Markets will scrutinize the minutes for clues on the November meeting following the hawkish unanimous September hike to 3.75-4.00%—the first since 2023—and Friday's sharp NFP miss.
key_facts: FOMC Sep 15-16 minutes due Oct 7 at 2PM ET
Sep hike was 12-0 unanimous vote to 3.75-4.00%
Oct 28 next FOMC; ~23% odds of another hike post-NFP miss

headline: Q3 2026 earnings season kicks off Oct 13 with JPMorgan; FactSet sees +29.1% EPS growth
summary: The Q3 2026 earnings season begins on October 13 when JPMorgan Chase reports before the open (EPS consensus $5.88). FactSet forecasts S&P 500 earnings grew 29.1% year-over-year in Q3 2026, which would mark the third consecutive quarter of above-25% EPS growth. Other major banks are expected to follow in the week of October 13.
key_facts: JPM Q3 earnings Oct 13 before open
FactSet: S&P 500 Q3 EPS growth +29.1% YoY

headline: Tesla is the only Magnificent Seven stock in the red for 2026, down ~23% YTD
summary: As of October 1, 2026, Tesla (TSLA) is the only member of the Magnificent Seven with a negative year-to-date return, down approximately 23% despite its Q3 deliveries beat. Apple and Nvidia are up over 23%, while Microsoft is up ~7%. TSLA's EV demand struggles and margin pressures have weighed on the stock.

headline: Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger set to close October 6
summary: The merger between Paramount Global and Warner Bros. Discovery is expected to close on October 6, 2026, creating one of the largest media and entertainment conglomerates. The deal aims to consolidate streaming and legacy media assets as both companies face pressure from Netflix and tech giants.
key_facts: Deal combines streaming platforms and legacy media assets

headline: Fed hiked 25bps to 3.75-4.00% in 12-0 vote on September 16, first hike since 2023
summary: The Federal Reserve delivered a unanimous 25 basis point rate hike on September 16, 2026, raising the federal funds target range to 3.75%-4.00%. This was the first hike since 2023. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish tone and the dot plot's call for one more 2026 hike rattled bond markets, pushing the 10-year yield to 5.26%.
key_facts: Dot plot: median sees 1 more hike in 2026

headline: US 10-year Treasury yield at 5.26%, near highest since 2002-2007
summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield stood at 5.26% on October 5, 2026, near its highest level since 2002-2007, sustained by the Federal Reserve's September hike to 3.75-4.00% and inflation running above 3%. The 2-year yield is approximately 4.90%. Elevated yields continue to pressure gold, growth stocks, and rate-sensitive sectors.

headline: ISM Manufacturing PMI hits 54.5 in September, continuing expansion
summary: The US ISM Manufacturing PMI registered 54.5 in September 2026, down slightly from August's 54.6, but remaining solidly in expansion territory and topping the consensus forecast of approximately 54.2. The reading pointed to continued strength in US factory activity.

headline: Nexalin Technology (NXL) surges 55% premarket on clinical data update
summary: Nexalin Technology (NXL) gapped up approximately 55% in Monday premarket trading on 12 million shares—133x its average volume—following a positive clinical data update. The surge made NXL one of the top premarket gainers on October 5, 2026.
key_facts: NXL +55.1% premarket on clinical data update

headline: Wells Fargo upgrades Consolidated Edison to Overweight, raises target to $118
summary: Wells Fargo upgraded Consolidated Edison (ED) to Overweight from Equal Weight and raised its price target to $118 from $108. Utility upgrades reflect rotation into defensive/dividend payers amid elevated Treasury yields.
key_facts: Wells Fargo upgrades ConEd to Overweight from Equal Weight

headline: 2026 US M&A tops $1.1 trillion in H1; over 40 deals above $10B
summary: Total US M&A deal values rose nearly 50% year-over-year to $1.111 trillion in H1 2026, with over 40 transactions valued above $10 billion. Major deals include Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern ($88.2B), SpaceX-Anysphere, Alphabet-Wiz ($23B), and Capital One-Discover ($35B). The IPO market also surged 68.6% YoY in volume, boosted by SpaceX's record public debut.
key_facts: SpaceX IPO largest in US history

headline: Apple tightens AI privacy rules; iPhone 18 demand robust in US; AAPL +23% YTD
summary: Apple is tightening AI privacy controls as analysts maintain a Buy rating, citing robust US iPhone 18 demand despite mixed global signals. Apple shares are up over 23% year-to-date in 2026, among the Magnificent Seven leaders.

headline: Bond markets brace for possible second 2026 hike; 30Y at 19-year high
summary: US Treasury markets remain under pressure with the 10-year yield at 5.26% and the 30-year near 19-year highs around 5.50%+. Fixed income traders are pricing in back-to-back Fed hikes for October and December 2026, though Friday's weak September jobs report shifted the odds toward a hold at the October 28 meeting. Sixteen of 18 Fed policymakers expect at least one more hike before year-end.
key_facts: 16 of 18 FOMC members expect ≥1 more hike in 2026
Post-NFP: Oct hike odds fell to ~23%
Core PCE still above 3% every month in 2026
